create_MultitaskLoss: create a MultitaskLoss module that combines camera, depth, and point losses for VGGT training
compute_camera_loss: compute camera pose loss with translation, rotation, and focal length components from predicted and ground truth pose encodings
compute_point_loss: compute 3D point reconstruction loss with confidence weighting and gradient regularization
compute_depth_loss: compute depth estimation loss with confidence weighting and gradient regularization
run_regression_loss: run confidence-weighted regression loss with optional multi-scale gradient loss for point or depth predictions
